patterns: how do i borrow a book

responses: Solent's Library is on five floors with WiFi throughout, hundreds of study spaces, bookable individual and group study rooms, and a student kitchen. Rooms can be booked up to 7 days ahead (up to 4 hours a day): https://libguides.solent.ac.uk/bookings/rooms. Opening hours were changing from September 2026, so please check the current times here: https://students.solent.ac.uk/studying/library/library-opening-times

patterns: does the university have a gym
how do i join a sports club
can i play football at university
responses: Yes. The Solent Sports Complex has a gym open to students, with monthly memberships and no contract. You can sign up on the Solent Sport app or at Sports Complex reception. Current prices, opening times and clubs are on https://sportscomplex.solent.ac.uk/ (please check there, as prices can change).

responses: Undergraduate applications are made through UCAS. For entry requirements, deadlines and how to apply for your course (including postgraduate and international applicants), see the course page on solent.ac.uk or contact the Admissions team: admissions@solent.ac.uk, 023 8201 5066.

patterns: do you have a data science course
how long is the masters course
tell me about your degree programmes
responses: Solent offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses across many subject areas. The course pages on solent.ac.uk list each course's content, entry requirements and length. For questions about a specific course, contact admissions@solent.ac.uk or 023 8201 5066.

patterns: how much are the tuition fees
how do i pay my fees
how much does it cost to study here
responses: Tuition fees vary by course, level of study and student status, so I can't give a single figure. International fees are published here: https://www.solent.ac.uk/finance/tuition-fees-explained/international-tuition-fees. For funding and money questions, email student.funding@solent.ac.uk. Scholarships and bursaries may be available, so check the Finance section on solent.ac.uk.

patterns: how do i apply for halls
when can i book a room
where do first year students live
responses: Solent has four halls of residence in the city centre, with around 1,000 single study-bedrooms (some en-suite). You apply online once Solent is your first choice and you have accepted an offer, and the FAQs explain the deadline for a guaranteed place. Details: https://solent.ac.uk/accommodation. Contact accommodation@solent.ac.uk or 023 8201 5040. For private housing, email private.housing@solent.ac.uk.

responses: For health and wellbeing advice, start with the Student Hub (student.hub@solent.ac.uk, 023 8201 5200), who can help with questions about your health and studies. You should register with a local GP. For urgent but non-emergency advice call NHS 111; in an emergency call 999.

patterns: do you help with finding jobs
can i get a part time job
how do i get an internship
responses: Solent Careers is free for students and graduates. It offers one-to-one guidance, CV help, placements and work experience, and a jobs board through Solent Careers Online. There is a drop-in in the Student Hub (check current times), or email careers@solent.ac.uk. More: https://students.solent.ac.uk/careers

patterns: how can i contact the university

responses: General enquiries: 023 8201 3000 (East Park Terrace, Southampton, SO14 0YN). Admissions: admissions@solent.ac.uk, 023 8201 5066. Student Hub (support with your course or personal matters): student.hub@solent.ac.uk, 023 8201 5200.

responses: I'm sorry you're going through this. I'm an automated assistant and can't give personal support, but Solent's Mental Health and Wellbeing team can help, and you can contact them at wellbeing@solent.ac.uk or through the Student Hub (student.hub@solent.ac.uk, 023 8201 5200). If you need help urgently, see https://students.solent.ac.uk/student-hub/mental-health-support/i-need-help-urgently. If you are in immediate danger, call 999, or call Samaritans free on 116 123, any time.
